digest.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
digest.tldr: The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.

digest.title: Microsoft fixes Teams, Outlook launch failures on ARM Windows PCs
digest.tldr: Microsoft has fixed a bug that prevented Teams and Outlook from launching on ARM-based Windows devices after installing updates released since the August 2026 Patch Tuesday.

digest.title: Claude is no longer available for minors
New 'BlueMoon' kit exploited Windows and Chrome zero-day flaws
digest.tldr: Multiple cyber-espionage groups deployed an exploit kit dubbed "BlueMoon" that leveraged zero-day vulnerabilities in Microsoft Windows and Google Chrome.
